snapshots.title: Installation and registry setup
snapshots.content:
Official setup: https://axuj.github.io/magicui-solid/docs/installation/

Begin with a SolidJS project configured for Tailwind CSS v4. The guide registers @magicui-solid in components.json using https://axuj.github.io/magicui-solid/r/{name}.json, with the project's actual CSS path and aliases. Follow its Solid-specific component installation flow; the React initialization flow does not apply.

Each component depends on @magicui-solid/theme. Installation supplies dependencies, CSS variables, Tailwind color mappings, radii and animation keyframes while retaining existing theme values. Manual copy-paste setup also needs the component's dependencies and matching theme CSS; the official guide provides the installation steps.

Col previews retain the published demos' Starlight Black theme and Geist typography. That documentation-site context differs from the installation theme defaults.
